title: Replay evidence beyond the Actions artifact lifetime
summary: Keep an approved replay origin and the run, attempt, artifact identity, digest and source pins needed for a later release review.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh verifier can reconstruct the documented two-version citation proof when the original Actions artifact is unavailable and can report any evidence that cannot be reconstructed.

evidence.claim: README trial identifies evidence review after artifact expiration as a reader task.
Existing release evidence rule remains authoritative.
